summary: The recorded base reproduces the reported CLIPImageProcessor.tokenizer AttributeError. The exact candidate removes that failure and correctly loads and attaches a separate tokenizer in real-processor and independent boundary tests. Full InternVL2_5-2B startup remains unverified because the prepared SentencePiece 0.2.2 rejects the model tokenizer's literal-NUL vocabulary piece after the candidate passes the original failure point.

tests.what_was_measured: Real Hugging Face metadata resolved to CLIPImageProcessor without tokenizer; base raised the reported AttributeError in get_tokenizer_from_processor.
Candidate bypassed the original AttributeError and invoked get_tokenizer; execution then stopped at the distinct SentencePiece literal-NUL error.
Candidate regression suite and surrounding processor/tokenizer behavior: 69 passed, 2 subtests passed.
Independent real-image-processor controlled-tokenizer path, downstream extraction, revision/backend propagation, combined processor, and tokenizer-as-processor boundaries.
Candidate patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) was visible, but this processor-resolution defect and candidate change are CPU/Python-only; no model weights or GPU inference were used.

remaining_counterexamples: With transformers 5.12.1 and SentencePiece 0.2.2 in the prepared environment, the real InternVL2_5-2B path still does not reach server readiness: tokenizer loading fails with 'piece must not include null character' after the original AttributeError is bypassed.
Full HTTP serving, model inference, semantic accuracy, and distributed behavior were not validated because model weights were not available or required for this device-independent review.
remaining_limitations: The candidate fixes the exact missing-tokenizer failure, but full original-model startup could not be independently demonstrated in the prepared dependency environment.
No GPU numerical execution was relevant or performed despite one assigned gfx950 GPU being visible.
No native source changed, so there was no native artifact to rebuild or validate.
